newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Radiomobil seeks 300 mln mark synd loan.
newsitem.headline: Czech Radiomobil seeks 300 mln mark synd loan.

text.p: Czech mobile telephone operator Radiomobil a.s., a Czech-German led joint venture, said on Tuesday that it is seeking a 300 million mark syndicated loan to help finance the construction of its GSM network.
Company officials said they expect a decision on the loan's lead arranger within the next two weeks.
"We have begun talks with Czech and foreign banks and we will analyse the offers," Radiomobil Financial Director Gustav Hraska told a new conference.
"In 14 days, we will come with a short list and hope that we can start to draw funds in the autumn," he added.
He gave no further details of conditions for the loan.
Radiomobil is a consortium led by DeTeMobil, and includes STET SpA of Italy and several Czech firms holding marginal stakes.
The consortium won a government tender to become a 49 percent partner in a joint venture with Ceske Radiokomunikace a.s., and launched its Global System for Mobile (GSM) system last year.
He added that for 1996, the firm financed its two billion crowns worth of investment entirely from its own sources and that it expects investment in 1997 to total some 5.3 billion crowns.

The company, 51 percent onwed by Ceske Radiokomunikace, started service in September last year as a competitor to Eurotel s.r.o., owned by fixed line operator SPT Telecom a.s., U.S. West Media Group, and Bell Atlantic Corp International.
